highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 previews the Skia m153 engine update and its upstream rendering corrections.
highlights_body: Linux applications that rely on fontconfig's exact fallback face should review the changed font fallback behavior before upgrading.

breaking.title: Linux font fallback may select a different face
breaking.body: Skia now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort fallback path, which can change selected glyphs or text metrics. Specify an explicit family and style, or use a bundled typeface, when deterministic font selection is required.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to Skia m153 and incorporates upstream Chrome m153 bug and correctness fixes.
Incorporates the upstream Chrome m153 fix for buffer uploads.

preview_summaries.v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6: Preview 1 opened the 4.153 line with the Skia m153 engine update and upstream rendering fixes.
preview_summaries.v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2: Release Candidate 1 validated the m153 preview line ahead of the stable release.

harfbuzz_summary: Hardens Windows libHarfBuzzSharp builds by narrowly scoping compiler warning suppressions.

v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 Preview 1 introduces the Skia m153 engine update.
v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.body: It also includes upstream Chrome m153 rendering fixes.

v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2.headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 Release Candidate 1 validates the Skia m153 preview line.
